criteria.requirement: Implement bidict.readonly.ReadOnlyBidictProxy as a read-only BidirectionalMapping with live forward/inverse lookups, stable inverse.inverse identity and inv alias. Preserve source order and live views after additions/deletions/clear, reject mutation in either direction and do not expose writable source through ordinary views. copy() returns an independent frozen snapshot. Preserve None, accept existing bidirectional subclasses and document that values are not deeply frozen and concurrency is not isolated.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
